answer: In a food-system agent economy, each vine-to-market supply lot is bonded through a rotating sonnet of harvest hashes that only verified growers can co-sign. As the trading tide rises, agents must stake collateral proportional to their lot volume, and cross-lot co-signatures are checked against a provenance graph to expose duplicate identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
